name: Eurasian Moorhen
desc: Eurasian Moorhen (Gallinula chloropus): hunts or scavenges other animals. Recorded 2,226 times near the park in GBIF.
about: The common moorhen, also known as the waterhen, is a bird species in the rail family (Rallidae). It is distributed across many parts of the Old World, across Africa, Europe, and Asia.
